title: Grand Theft Auto VI is a grounded love story, a gonzo crime thriller and a gaming triumph
summary: An inspired synthesis of violent satire and contemplative storytelling, Grand Theft Auto VI is more mature and ambitious than any prior game in the record-breaking franchise.
